meta.title: Australian financial advice implementation forms: taxonomy and provider examples
notes: Form codes and versions change often. Treat every URL as a starting point and re-check before relying on it.
Many funds now push members to online flows (MemberAccess, adviser portals). Paper PDFs still exist for advisers and edge cases.
verify=true means the entry came from general industry knowledge, not a document found in this research pass.

providers.name: BT Panorama (Panorama Super, Panorama Investments)
providers.trustee_admin: BT Funds Management Ltd (trustee), BT Portfolio Services Ltd (administrator)
providers.channel: Adviser portal service requests plus PDF forms (BTFxxxxx codes)

providers.name: Rest Super (Rest Super, Rest Corporate, Rest Pension)
providers.channel: Mostly online via MemberAccess and Rest App; PDFs for binding nominations, insurance, change of details

providers.name: Hostplus
providers.channel: Online pension application (pensions.hostplus.com.au) plus numbered PDF forms (e.g. 1184.3, 1195.x, 1223.x)

providers.name: MUFG Pension & Market Services (formerly Link Group)
providers.type: administrator and share registry, not a fund

divisions.MUFG Retirement Solutions: Back office super administration for many funds. Forms are branded by the client fund, not MUFG.
divisions.MUFG Corporate Markets: Share registry for ASX issuers (e.g. Westpac, BOQ). Forms: change of address, off-market transfer, DRP, TFN notification, direct credit, merge holdings.

providers.name: Leveraged Equities (Bendigo and Adelaide Bank subsidiary)
providers.channel: Online application with adviser prefill and client handover; PDF maintenance forms

providers.name: Australian Taxation Office
providers.channel: Approved forms lodged with the super fund, not the ATO (NOI, splitting, downsizer)

categories.name: Debt recycling / gearing implementation
categories.description: No single 'debt recycling form'. Implemented through a bundle: loan split, redraw or limit increase, investment account opening, and optionally margin lending.
bundle_steps: Loan split request (lender form or phone call, no new credit if total debt unchanged)
Loan increase / top-up application (full credit application if total debt rises)
Investment account application (platform, broker or wrap)
Optional: margin loan application, nominate adviser, refinance-in, security transfer

examples.form: Margin Loan application (Ord Minnett branded example)
Forms library (increase limit, security transfer, platform nomination, etc.)
